title: Wrasse Configuration
description: Configuration file for the Wrasse Kotlin compiler plugin

extends.description: Path to a base config file (relative to this file). Child values override base values.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude from all rules

format.description: The opinionated printer: a single on/off switch plus its style parameters (no per-rule format toggles).

enabled.description: Turn the printer on. Defaults to true when the 'format' object itself is present.

maxLineLength.description: Column width the printer wraps to. Default 140.

trailingCommas.description: Whether the printer adds a trailing comma to multiline call-site and declaration-site lists. Default true.

importLayout.description: Import ordering the printer enforces. Default 'ascii'.

multilineSignatureThreshold.description: Parameter count at or above which a function or primary-constructor signature is forced one-parameter-per-line. Absent: signatures wrap only when exceeding maxLineLength.

rules.description: Rule configurations. Absent rules default to off (or inherit from base via extends).

complex-condition.description: Disallow a condition combining 3 or more && / || operators

cyclomatic-complexity.description: Disallow a function whose cyclomatic complexity exceeds 14

destructuring-declaration-with-too-many-.description: Disallow a destructuring declaration with more than 3 entries

file-size.description: Disallow a file longer than 2000 lines

function-name-max-length.description: Disallow a function name longer than 30 characters

function-name-min-length.description: Disallow a function name shorter than 3 characters

large-class.description: Disallow a class longer than 600 code lines

long-method.description: Disallow a function longer than 60 code lines

long-parameter-list.description: Disallow more than 5 function parameters (6 for constructors)

nested-block-depth.description: Disallow nesting deeper than 4 levels within a function

return-count.description: Disallow a function with more than 2 return statements

throws-count.description: Disallow a function with more than 2 throw statements

too-many-functions.description: Disallow more than 11 functions in a file, class, interface, object, or enum

also-could-be-apply.description: Disallow an also block whose body only uses its receiver

equals-null-call.description: Disallow calling equals(null) instead of a null comparison

explicit-it-lambda-multiple-parameters.description: Disallow naming a multi-parameter lambda's parameter 'it'

forbidden-comment.description: Disallow TODO:, FIXME:, and STOPSHIP: comment markers

function-only-returning-constant.description: Disallow a function whose body only returns a constant

may-be-constant.description: Disallow a compile-time-constant val that could be declared const

nested-classes-visibility.description: Disallow a nested class more visible than its outer class

safe-cast.description: Disallow an is-check followed by a cast instead of as?

string-should-be-raw-string.description: Disallow an escape-heavy string literal better written as a raw string

trim-multiline-raw-string.description: Disallow a multiline raw string without trimIndent or trimMargin

unused-parameter.description: Disallow a declared function parameter that is never read

unused-private-class.description: Disallow a private class that is never referenced in its file

use-let.description: Disallow a null-check block better written as ?.let

backing-property-naming.description: Require a leading-underscore backing property to be lowerCamelCase with a public correlated member

enum-entry-naming.description: Require PascalCase or SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE enum entry names

filename.description: Require a file's name to match its sole top-level class/object, or be PascalCase

package-naming.description: Require lowercase dotted package names with no underscores

property-naming.description: Require camelCase property names; SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE for const val

empty-default-constructor.description: Disallow an empty primary constructor with no annotations or modifiers

explicit-it-lambda-parameter.description: Disallow explicitly declaring a lambda's own single 'it' parameter

long-numerical-values.description: Require underscore separators in long numeric literals

range-conventional.description: Require conventional range forms: .. over rangeTo(), until over ..(x - 1)

trivial-accessors.description: Disallow trivial get()/set() accessors that only read or write the backing field

if-else-bracing.description: Require braces around a bare if/else branch belonging to a multi-line if-statement

redundant-constructor-keyword.description: Disallow a redundant 'constructor' keyword on an unmodified primary constructor

unnecessary-backticks.description: Disallow backtick-quoted identifiers whose escaping is unnecessary

modifier-order.description: Require modifiers to appear in the Kotlin coding-conventions canonical order

no-empty-class-body.description: Disallow class/interface/object/enum bodies containing nothing but whitespace

no-empty-parens-before-trailing-lambda.description: Disallow an empty '()' argument list immediately before a trailing lambda

no-unit-return.description: Disallow a redundant explicit ': Unit' return type on a block-body function

redundant-visibility-modifier.description: Disallow a redundant explicit 'public' visibility modifier on a class, function, or property

import-ordering.description: Require import directives to be in plain ASCII-alphabetical order

no-unused-imports.description: Disallow imports whose target is never referenced in the file

no-unnecessary-fqn.description: Disallow fully qualified names that could be dropped given an existing or addable import (report-only)

trailing-newline.description: Require a trailing newline at end of file

when-entry-bracing.description: Require braces around a bare when-entry body when some sibling entry is already braced and some entry has a multiline body

undocumented-public-class.description: Disallow an undocumented top-level public class, interface, or object (active only under Kotlin's explicit API mode)

undocumented-public-function.description: Disallow an undocumented top-level public function (active only under Kotlin's explicit API mode)

undocumented-public-property.description: Disallow an undocumented top-level public property (active only under Kotlin's explicit API mode)

kdoc-tag-mismatch.description: Disallow a KDoc's @param/@property tags that don't match the declaration's own parameters

kdoc-deprecated-tag.description: Disallow a KDoc @deprecated block tag; use the @Deprecated annotation instead

comment-over-private-declaration.description: Disallow a KDoc attached to a private function or property

too-generic-exception-caught.description: Disallow catching an overly generic exception type

too-generic-exception-thrown.description: Disallow throwing an overly generic exception type

print-stack-trace.description: Disallow Thread.dumpStack() and a caught exception's own printStackTrace()

rethrow-caught-exception.description: Disallow a catch block that only rethrows its own caught exception unmodified

empty-catch-block.description: Disallow a catch block containing nothing but whitespace

not-implemented-declaration.description: Disallow throw NotImplementedError(...) and a TODO(...) call with zero or one arguments

instance-of-check-for-exception.description: Disallow an is-check or unsafe cast against a caught exception inside its own catch body

swallowed-exception.description: Disallow a caught exception that is never referenced anywhere in its own catch body

empty-secondary-constructor.description: Disallow an empty secondary constructor body

empty-function-block.description: Disallow an empty function body, unless open or a member of an interface

empty-when-block.description: Disallow a when expression with zero entries

empty-kotlin-file.description: Disallow a file with no content beyond its own package declaration

unconditional-jump-statement-in-loop.description: Disallow a loop whose entire body is a single unconditional break or return

loop-with-too-many-jump-statements.description: Disallow a loop containing more than one break or continue statement

custom-label.description: Disallow a custom label on a return/break/continue that no nested loop or forEach needs to disambiguate

double-negative.description: Disallow an expression negated more than once via chained ! operators

constructor-parameter-naming.description: Disallow a constructor parameter name that is not lowerCamelCase

variable-name-max-length.description: Disallow a property or variable name longer than 64 characters

level.description: Rule severity: 'off' disables, 'warn' reports as warning, 'error' reports as error

exclude.description: Additional glob patterns to exclude for this rule
